wave.notes: Truth = typed FUNC/THUMB_FUNC symbols of the ELF built on nih-vps-u (ninja; ROM sha1 identical to the delivered file; `ninja` CHECK step OK). Sizes are the ELF symbol sizes; 35 asm functions carry no size (0). verified=1 for functions in units compiled from C (src/*.c); asm units (m4a_1, libagbsyscall, transform*, movie_codec blob) and libgcc/libc members are verified=0. movie_codec.o symbols (MovieDeltaCodecStart etc., 7) are data-and-code blobs labelled FUNC by the repo and are verified=0. wave.compiler: MWCC GC/2.6 (95.7% of linked code bytes), GC/1.2.5n (4.3% of linked code bytes)
wave.notes: truth: functions = dtk symbols.txt entries with type:function (stripped excluded), start/size from the symbol; verified=1 iff the function lies in a splits.txt unit whose configure.py Object(...) status evaluates to Matching (configure.py executed for this version; NonMatching/Equivalent/missing units and code outside any named unit => 0). linked_percent = verified function bytes / all listed function bytes (bytes, all modules). Rev 0 disc, hash matches repo GPVE01. Strictly-linked units cover 98.09% of listed function bytes (request list cited 99.6%, likely a different measure). Single DOL. Import: ok, single image, no importer blockers specific to this image.

Compression: none for code (MIO0 only for textures/level data, not functions). main = .main (ROM 0x1000..0xf5580 -> 0x80246000, equals the linear boot view) ; module `engine` = Goddard segment (ROM 0xf5580..0x108a10 raw -> 0x80378800) is not at its linear address. rsp ucode excluded. 7 libultra statics without symbols (e.g. _Printf, _Ldtob members) boundaries from a branch-aware splitter, verified=0. __osExceptionPreamble/__osException curated by hand (labels inside it dropped). Import mapping (romwright N64): native/n64.rs maps ROM[0x1000..] linearly at the header boot address (word 0x08) plus the whole ROM at 0x10000000; only a ROM whose header CRC1/CRC2/game code is in native/n64_layouts.json (today only Perfect Dark NTSC-final) is loaded as real segments through native/n64_segments.rs (each segment = ROM parts decoded by n64_codec [raw, deflate, rare-1172/1173/-pages, mio0, yay0, yaz0], placed at boot/at/after; two segments may not overlap in RDRAM). Overlays are placed by native/n64_overlays.rs import_set(rom, [(name, rom_offset, codec, load_address, stored size)]): one NativeImport per overlay, mapped at its load address, module kind overlay. functions.tsv `start` is the VRAM link address of the decoded segment/overlay (module=main: resident segments, one address space; any other module: its own program at its load_address, so overlays sharing a vram never collide). truth/layout.json lists every resident segment and overlay (ROM range, codec, vram, decoded size) in n64_layouts.json schema so a harness can build Layout/import_set input; it is NOT in the shipped catalog, so a stock romwright import of this ROM is the linear view and only `linear_visible` main functions line up.
